captions_on_screen: text box, three lines, white text with emoji, centred over the product from 0 s to the end; no subtitles.
editing_rhythm: About 6 shots; one 39.5 s static take, then five shots in the last 5.5 s of roughly 1 s each (shot boundaries estimated from contact sheets, ffmpeg found no cuts). The paper slide and card change inside the main take look like time-lapse or sped-up sections (interpretation).
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s show the coloured drawings. On-screen text 'כתבי "רובוט" בתגובות' all the way through. Caption: follow the page, tag a friend, write the word "רובוט" in the comments and the link is sent in DM.
convincing: Interpretation: watching a real drawing form with no cuts is the proof; the plain home setting makes it feel like a real parent filmed it. The CTA sits on screen from 0 s.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: no voice or face, no child, no price, no explanation of age range or how cards work. 39 s of the same wide shot with little change after the first minute of drawing.
